main.description: A software project. The record key is the project name itself, making duplicate names per repo impossible and enabling AppView-free resolution. Name grammar (normative prose): 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII alphanumerics and interior hyphens only, no dots or colons, no leading or trailing hyphen.

name.description: Machine name of the project. MUST equal the record key. Serves as URL segment, uniqueness key, display fallback, and install token.

renamedTo.description: When set, this project has been renamed: the record persists as a permanent alias to the successor software.release.project. Record keys are immutable, so rename is never an in-place edit and an old name is never reusable.

parent.description: An AT URI to a software.release.project that this project either derives or descends from.
